snooze.defect: AC-002 'snoozes for a sensible time' has no number or rule: untestable.

search.defect: AC-001 'returns the relevant reminders' never defines relevance or order: untestable.

list-speed.defect: AC-002 'fast enough' has no threshold, input size or machine: untestable.

duration-format.defect: AC-001's expected values come from calling format_left itself: the oracle cannot fail.

export-golden.defect: AC-001's golden file is produced by the new exporter and then compared with the same exporter's output.

ids.defect: AC-001 checks new_id() against a set built by calling new_id(), so a constant id passes.

tags.defect: No Non-Goals: nothing bounds tag search, tag renaming, colours or sync, and 'tags everywhere' invites scope creep.

share.defect: No Non-Goals or limits on what is sent: sharing could mail the whole save file; recipients, privacy and transport are unbounded.

undo.defect: No Non-Goals: undo of which operations, how many steps, and whether history persists across runs are all open.

cap.defect: AC-001 rejects a count above 52 but AC-002 clamps it to 52: the two cannot both hold.

zone-error.defect: AC-001 says an unknown zone exits 0 with a warning; AC-002 says the same input exits 2.

import-ids.defect: AC-001 keeps the export's ids; AC-002 requires every imported reminder to get a new id.
